tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bse rag bkar ba bsdus pa ni/1$0000300 na mo ārya dzaṃ bha la ya/

kha 'gong che na changs bu ting lo dang*/ kha lhag bo gtor shor ba bsdus la blugs/ a kā ro sa byin rlabs byas la/ bse rag kha 'gong mdun du 'gug gzhug byas nas/ yi dam sngags sham la 'di btags thun gyis brab/ oṃ 'grig shog /na mo kha la dun tse rbad/ nag mo za 'dre mi la kha chings/ 'grig shog /dun hab dul dul nan rbad/ myag myag bse rag kha chings/ mi la kha chings/ chung sri'i kha chings/ nad 'dre'i kha chings/ rabs chad kyi kha chings/ ci mang bzla/ kye/ bse rag mi la gzhon nu pa// bu chung lus la g.yu rna can// stag ral gzig shubs gri chung rked// dar zab pad ris phyags lh+wam can// 'phru btsugs lag na sdud mo gzung*// sreg pa bdun ni klad na lding*// ri bong 'chibs shing dung so can// mig rno skra ni kham pa ste// bse rag ltog 'gong mang pos bskor// changs bu ting lo kha lhag 'dis/ khyed cag 'khor bcas tshims gyur cig /gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// phyin chad 'khor 'dir ma gnod cig /kha zas changs bu 'di khyer la// za kha 'thung kha dgra la spos// zad med za rgyu de na yod// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi// dam la ma 'da' da song zhig /sumbha ni sogs brjod/ thun gyis brabs la phyi rol du dor bcug /srung 'khor bsgom/ 'di byas pas chang lad pa dang*/ 'o ma la mar mi thon pa dang*/ tshong nyes/ bor gtor/ chag nyams/ 'gong po bse rag kha 'gong zhi zhing gnod pa thams cad la phan/ zhes o rgyan gyis mdzad pa'i don rā ga a syas bsdus pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ 'di la rang yi dam lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang bcas sngags cung zad bzlas rjes gtor ma/ a kā ro lan gsum phyag rgya bcas pas brlabs/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// chos skyong srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis// gnod byed kha 'gong bse rag kun// mchod sbyin gnas 'dir myur du khug

/gnod byed kha 'gong bse rag thams cad ā karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ lan gsum gyis bkug / na massarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun gyis bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ de nas sngags bzla zhing thun gyis gzir ba man bya'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
